# Script to run codeml 

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
#!/bin/bash -l

#SBATCH -J codeml         #job name
#SBATCH --mail-type FAIL,END   #mail events (e.g. NONE, BEGIN, END, FAIL, ALL)
#SBATCH --mail-user Julia.Levinstein@campus.lmu.de
#SBATCH -t 2-00:00:00         #booking time d-hh:mm:ss
#SBATCH --clusters=biohpc_gen
#SBATCH --partition=biohpc_gen_normal
#SBATCH --nodelist=cm4r13c06s10
#SBATCH -n 1
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1


source $(conda info --base)/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate /dss/dsslegfs01/pr53da/pr53da-dss-0036/projects/2025__neosex/envs/phylogenetics

MAIN_DIR=/dss/dsslegfs01/pr53da/pr53da-dss-0036/projects/2025__neosex/neosex_project/fusion_dating/Meliphagidae/autosomal_genes/PAML_constraint_str

for dir in "$MAIN_DIR"/*; do

    if [ -d "$dir" ]; then
        echo "Processing directory: $dir"

        # Start a subshell
        (
            cd "$dir" || exit 1
            if [ -f "codeml.ctl" ]; then
                codeml codeml.ctl > codeml.log 2>&1
            else
                echo "Warning: codeml.ctl not found in $dir"
            fi
        )
        # back to $MAIN_DIR
    fi
done

```
